title: Hidden Issue Flags
description: v1 wiring contract (lane C packet W0; plan docs/PRODUCT_PLAN_CURRENT_2026-09-28.md section 8a, queue item B-09) for the hidden-issue flag layer: the §8a groups checked on every property, each item shown as a flag, an opportunity, or 'Check needed' when the data is not available. The document is the serialized FlagGroup.to_dict() output of services/api/app/profile/hidden_issue_flags/ (model.py FlagGroup / HiddenIssueFlag), wrapped in a version envelope. This layer carries NO legal meaning and computes nothing about the law: a flag only reports what the sourced data already shows, or says the source is not available (a missing source is always 'Check needed', never a guess). Legal determinations belong to the rule engine (Lane A) and a qualified reviewer at G6, never here. There are four groups (existing_building, zoning_lot_history, map_based_rules, site_shape_and_street); the zoning-lot-history group is a reminder only, so its items are a flag or 'Check needed' and never claim a verified or combined zoning lot.

contract_version.description: CLOSED enum of published hidden_issue_flags contract versions. 1.0.0 = lane C packet W0 initial shape. New versions are admitted only by an accepted contract task that appends to this enum.

groups.description: The §8a flag groups, one FlagGroup.to_dict() per group. Each group_id is one of the four §8a group ids; a study may carry a subset while groups are wired in.

_expected_failure.description: FIXTURE-ONLY annotation stating the intended defect of an invalid fixture (packages/contracts README convention). Producers NEVER emit this key; it is allowed (optional) so an invalid fixture fails only for its stated defect under additionalProperties:false.

flag_group.description: One §8a group as its flags (model.py FlagGroup.to_dict()).

group_id.description: The §8a group id (services/api/app/profile/hidden_issue_flags/*.py GROUP_ID). CLOSED enum of the four groups.

lot_bbl.description: The tax lot (10-digit BBL) the flags are for.

flags.description: The item flags, in plan order (HiddenIssueFlag.to_dict()).

flag.description: One §8a item as a flag, opportunity, check_needed or not_flagged (model.py HiddenIssueFlag.to_dict()).

group.description: The §8a group id this item belongs to (HiddenIssueFlag.group).

status.description: model.py STATUSES: flag = the sourced data shows an issue; opportunity = the sourced data shows a gain; check_needed = the source is missing or not connected (never a negative claim); not_flagged = the source IS available and shows no issue.

status_label.description: The display label, tied one-to-one to status (model.py LABELS). 'Check needed' is the plan section 8a wording, copied exactly.

detail.description: The one line shown beside the affected results (plan section 5a). For check_needed it names the missing source plainly.

typical_source.description: The §8a 'Typical source' for this item (what would answer it).

evidence.description: The inputs this flag was drawn from, each {label, source}.

fact_refs.description: The fact_id of each site fact this flag draws on, so a consumer can tie the flag to the facts and their 'Out of date' status.

exception_label.description: A results exception label beside the number, such as 'Out of date', or null.

phase.description: The §8a phase for this item ('1' for the existing-building group).

allOf.description: The display label is tied one-to-one to the status (model.py LABELS).

The zoning-lot-history group is a reminder only (plan P-2): its items are a flag or 'Check needed', never opportunity or not_flagged, and never a verified or combined zoning-lot claim. Every other group admits all four statuses.

evidence_item.description: One input a flag was drawn from, {label, source}.

source.description: The input's provenance object (the site_fact source summary), or null for an input with no dataset.
